correctness.rationale: Rotations preserve Hamming weight, forcing at least two changed positions. Thus nonidentity outputs from windows three or more apart cannot coincide. Every distinct outcome is counted once by its earliest window, yielding an exact six-bit local score. The 32-state max-plus recurrence maximizes over all prefixes. Exact 32-entry equality \(v_{11}(s)=v_6(s)+11\) implies the all-n period-five maximum via translation equivariance; base cases \(n=4,\ldots,10\) are checked. The period-five 01110 witness attains the bound by local reward pattern 2,2,2,2,3. The packaged Python verifier replays the pivotal equality independently by direct enumeration of all \(n\le11\) words and checks all local values and witnesses.

value.rationale: The source identifies four-bit nanopore windows as a concrete application and treats errors within these windows as an active coding-model concern. The exact worst-case radius-one neighborhood size is a natural decoding ambiguity and finite packing input. Replacing the trivial \(3n-8\) upper bound by the sharp \(\lfloor(11n-20)/5\rfloor\), together with explicit period-five attainability and a rigorous 32-state certificate, is a structural, all-blocklength result rather than a random small-instance computation. A priori the exact slope and periodic witness are not implied by the source asymptotics.
